_comment: Route B (decision-graph) vocabulary, covering all ~73 workflows across the 10 categories. The step vocab (actions/objects/systems) is reused from taxonomy.json; this file adds the presenting problem (trigger), the condition that gates a branch (guard), and the terminal state (outcome). Each is coerced during validation; unknown -> 'other' (guard -> null when none stated). Triggers are grouped by category in comments only — the extractor sees a flat name->description list. Free-text intent/guard_detail/outcome_intent carry the workflow-specific colour alongside these coded values.

triggers.password_forgotten: User forgot a password or it expired
triggers.account_locked: Account locked out / too many bad sign-ins
triggers.login_failure: Cannot sign in for a reason other than a plain lockout
triggers.mfa_issue: MFA lost, new device, or not prompting
triggers.access_request: Request for access/permission to a resource
triggers.new_hire_onboarding: Provision a new starter (accounts, mailbox, licence)
triggers.license_request: Assign, change, or remove a licence
triggers.mailbox_access_request: Access to a shared or another user's mailbox
triggers.group_membership_change: Add/remove a user from a group or distribution list
triggers.policy_change_request: Change a conditional-access / security / config policy
triggers.device_lifecycle_request: Enrol, wipe, or retire a managed device
triggers.profile_update_request: Change a user attribute or profile field
triggers.monitoring_alert: Automated RMM / health / uptime / third-party monitoring alert fired
triggers.backup_failure: Backup job failed, needs restore, or a backup status check
triggers.certificate_expiry: SSL / domain certificate expiring or needs renewal
triggers.server_maintenance: Scheduled maintenance, patching, or planned server work
triggers.server_provisioning: New server / VPS / hosting build or service request
triggers.performance_degradation: Slowness or high CPU/memory/resource on a device or server
triggers.service_outage: A service, server, or system is down / not responding
triggers.security_alert: Security alert to triage (EDR/XDR/MDR, identity-threat, malware, dark-web)
triggers.phishing_report: Suspicious / phishing email reported by a user
triggers.compliance_review: Security-control check, compliance report, or monitoring review
triggers.spam_management: Spam filter change or quarantine release
triggers.client_onboarding: Onboard a new managed client / tenant (MSSP)
triggers.hardware_fault: Workstation, laptop, or peripheral hardware not working
triggers.software_issue: Application error, crash, or general software support
triggers.procurement_request: Request to buy / install hardware or software
triggers.peripheral_setup: Set up a monitor, dock, mouse, or other peripheral
triggers.print_issue: Printer setup, configuration, or not printing
triggers.connectivity_issue: Network / internet / WiFi connectivity or performance problem
triggers.account_inquiry: General account inquiry or fault report
triggers.unclassified: Catch-all: long-tail, untagged, or unclassifiable ticket
triggers.other: A real trigger that fits nothing above

guards.self_service_failed: Self-service / portal path did not work, needed manual action
guards.hybrid_account: Account is synced/hybrid, so the change was needed in more than one directory
guards.still_failing: The attempted fix did not resolve it; issue persisted
guards.resolved_after_action: The action worked and the issue was resolved
guards.no_customer_reply: Waiting on the customer / no response
guards.awaiting_approval: Blocked pending manager or change approval
guards.missing_info: Request lacked required detail; had to go back for it
guards.requires_escalation: Beyond first-line; handed to another team or vendor
guards.account_not_found: The target account/object did not exist
guards.false_positive: Alert/finding assessed as benign or a false positive
guards.confirmed_threat: Alert/finding assessed as a genuine threat needing action
guards.reboot_resolved: A restart / reboot cleared the issue
guards.config_error_found: A misconfiguration was identified as the cause
guards.out_of_scope: Not this team's responsibility / outside the contract
guards.other: A real branch condition that fits nothing above

outcomes.resolved_first_contact: Resolved in a single touch, no follow-up
outcomes.resolved_after_followup: Resolved, but only after further contact / a second session
outcomes.reopened: Reopened or re-raised under another workflow after a failed fix
outcomes.escalated_internal: Handed off to a colleague/team and left there
outcomes.escalated_vendor: Raised with a supplier/third party and left there
outcomes.monitored: Left running / under observation to confirm it does not recur
outcomes.dismissed_false_positive: Alert/report reviewed and dispositioned as benign; no action needed
outcomes.resolved_unspecified: Notes say resolved but give no detail of what was done
outcomes.no_action: Closed with no technical work (duplicate, out of scope, self-resolved)
outcomes.other: A real terminal state that fits nothing above
